desc:
🔥 Policy Sins - Chapter 1: Smoke 🔥

A co-op horror game for 1-5 players. You are a group of officials on a "work visit" to Lubuk Asap Village, a village engulfed in smoke from peatland fires.. due to the permits you signed yourselves.

Help the citizens, collect mysterious fragments, and survive attacks from the spirits of victims demanding justice. Every important decision is made through voting, determining the fate of everyone.

✦ Story-based co-op horror (1-5 players)
✦ Low-poly PSX visual style
✦ Smoke waves: find a room to breathe
✦ Please help the fainting friend before it's too late
✦ Minigames for tasks, NPCs, and village secrets
✦ 3 endings: Citizen Rampage, Eternal Chair, Last Breath
✦ Official HP with the RUMPI application

Controls: [E] Interact • [J] Evidence Notes • [H] Official Health Points

⚠️ All characters, institutions, and countries of the "Greater Nusantara Republic" are fictional. Any similarities in names or events are purely coincidental.
